topic: How we work: building a mobile app step by step
caption:
How does a mobile app go from idea to the App Store and Google Play? Here's how we approach it. 📱

1️⃣ Scope: the core user journey and what v1 needs
2️⃣ Design: clickable screens you review before we build
3️⃣ Build: app and backend together, often with React Native
4️⃣ Test: on real iOS and Android devices
5️⃣ Release & improve: store submission, then updates

A clear process means fewer surprises for you. Swipe through for each step. →

Got an app idea? DM us BUILD and tell us what it should do.

slides.title:
How we build
a mobile app.
slides.sub: Step by step, from idea to the app stores.

slides.title: Scope
slides.body: We map the core user journey and agree on what version one needs, and what can wait.

slides.title: Design
slides.body: Clickable screens first. You review the flow before a line of app code is written.

slides.title: Build
slides.body: App and backend built together, often with React Native so iOS and Android share one codebase.

slides.title: Test
slides.body: We test on real iOS and Android devices, not just simulators, before anything ships.

slides.title: Release & improve
slides.body: App Store and Google Play submission, then updates based on real usage.
